text: “You have had your bottle, I perceive, Sydney.” “Two to-night, I think. I have been dining with the day’s client; or seeing him dine--it’s all one!” “That was a rare point, Sydney, that you brought to bear upon the identification. How did you come by it? When did it strike you?” “I thought he was rather a handsome fellow, and I thought I should have been much the same sort of fellow, if I had had any luck.” Mr. Stryver laughed till he shook his precocious paunch. “You and your luck, Sydney!
